actions.label: inspect-flower
actions.instruction: Lift one pink flower to eye level with the right hand, rotate the wrist clockwise to inspect it, pause, then lower it without placing it in the vase.
actions.timeline: 0.000-1.000 s: approach and grasp one pink stem with the right hand; 1.000-2.200 s: lift the flower to the robot's eye level; 2.200-3.200 s: rotate the right wrist clockwise by about 45 degrees while keeping the elbow stable; 3.200-4.100 s: pause with the flower held in front of the dark face panel; 4.100-5.167 s: lower the flower slightly while maintaining the grasp. The left hand remains away from the vase.
